details.purpose: *For recording the results of a measurement of refractive error, which is commonly referred to as performing a refraction. (en)
details.use:
*Use to record the results and contextual parameters of a measurement of refractive error.
Use to record both subjective and objective measurements of a refractive error.
Use to record both examiner-led subjective refration and autorefractometer-based subjective refraction.
Use to record the result of static retinoscopy, (en)
details.misuse:
*Not to be used to record a spectacle or contact lens prescription.
Not to be used to record the correction used during other tests, such as visual acuity tests.
Not to be used to record the results of an overrefraction, which is a measurement of the residual refractive error while a correction is being used. No appropriate Archetype is available at this time.
Not to be used to record the results of measurements of accomodative capabilty, including dynamic retinoscopy. No appropriate Archetype is available at this time. (en)

items.items: Measurements of the refractive error of an individual's eyes, which would need to be corrected for light to be appropriately focused on the retina.
Details of the device used to measure refraction.
Not to be used for information about how the test was performed or patient circumstances affecting result.
Patient circumstances which affect interpretation of the result. Often termed 'reliability' in opthalmological documentation.
Default, unspecified point in time or interval event which may be explicitly defined in a template or at run-time.
Details to explicitly record that this test was not performed.
Additional information required to capture local content or to align with other reference models/formalisms.
For example: local information requirements or additional metadata to align with FHIR or CIMI equivalents.
Identification of the eye which was tested.
Assessment of the right eye was performed.
Assessment of the left eye was performed.
The type of method that was used to perform the measurement.
The measurement was performed by automated objective refractomery, commonly refered to as autorefractometry.
Subjective refraction was performed by a human examiner based on patient feedback.
Subjective refraction was perfomed in an automated manner based on patient feedback.
The individuals assumed accommodative function during the measurement of refractive error.
Coding with a terminology is recommended. Free text entry should only be permitted if no appropriate coded value is available.
The measurement was perfomed by retinoscopy.
The refractive error that is equal in all meridians.
The refractive error added to the spherical error at the meridian 90° from the cylinder axis, reflecting the degree of cylindrical astigmatism.
The orientation of the cylinder of the refractive error in degrees.
The (virtual or real) distance between the eye and the object from which the light rays should be focused on the retina if the measured refractive error is corrected.
The calculated spherical equivalent of the refractive error.
The interpupillary distance which was set in the device used to measure the refractive error.

Not an observation or measurement of the tested individual's true interpupillary distance, but rather a recording of the interpupillary distance which was set in the testing device (such as a phoropter) during the measurement of refractive error. Measurements of Interpupillary distances will be recorded in another archetype.
Statement describing the condition of the individual's pupils during the measurement.

Comment: The physical examination of the eye will be recorded using the CLUSTER.exam-eye family of archetypes. Coding with a terminology is recommended. Free text entry should only be permitted if no appropriate coded value is available.
The diameter of the pupil which is assumed to have been present during the measurement of refractive error
Typically based on an observation or measurement of pupil diameter which may be recorded in a separate OBSERVATION.
The pupil is in its natural physiological state without pharmacological intervention or pathological changes.
The pupil was dilated due to prior administration of mydriatic agents.
The pupil was constricted due to prior administration of miotic agents.
The pupil was in an unphysiological state due to disease, trauma, or structural abnormalities.
A categorisation of the targeted distance.
The vertex distance that was assumed or measured as a basis for the measurement of refractive error.
Detailed information typically only produced during retinoscopy.
###Might be better off in a separate CLUSTER Archetype that can be slotted in here####
Detailed information typically only produced by autorefractometers
###Might be better off in a separate CLUSTER Archetype that can be slotted in here####
The refractive error that is equal in all meridians.
The refractive error added to the spherical error at the meridian 90° from the cylinder axis, reflecting the degree of cylindrical astigmatism.
The orientation of the cylinder of the refractive error in degrees.
The refractive error was estimated via a direct ophthalmoscope.
Due to use of cycloplegic eye drops, the ability to accomodate was considered functionally abolished.
Due to use of cycloplegic eye drops, the ability to accomodate was considered reduced, but not to a complete or near-complete degree.
Accommodation was deemd impossible for other reasons, such as the absence of the natural lens.
A reduced abiliy to accommodate was present for pathological reasons.
Due to use of cycloplegic eye drops, the ability to accomodate was considered strongly reduced, but not abolished.
Detailed information typically only produced during examiner-led subjective refraction.

Pasientfeilkilder som innvirker på tolkning av reultatet.
Eksempel: Pasient med nedsatt bevissthet eller manglende samarbeidsevne.
Standard, uspesifisert tidspunkt eller tidsintervall som kan defineres mer eksplisitt i en template eller i en applikasjon.
Detaljert om hvorfor undersøkelsen ikke ble utført.
Ytterligere informasjon som trengs for å kunne registrere lokalt definert innhold eller for å tilpasse til andre referansemodeller/formalismer.
For eksempel lokale informasjonsbehov eller ytterligere metadata for å kunne tilpasse til tilsvarende konsepter i FHIR eller CIMI.
Identifikasjon av hvilket øye som blir undersøkt.
Undersøkelse av pasientens høyre øye ble utført.
Undersøkelse av pasientens venstre øye ble utført.
